plan.title: Create and publish Technical Stage plus RFQ eRFX

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Create the requested Technical Stage and RFQ combination.
Assert that both requested stage tabs were created.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
Add a catalogue line item through the line-item drawer.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
Commit the event schedule required for publication.
Invite the mapped catalogue vendors to the event.
Publish the completed project and wait for the product's outcome.
Assert that the project was created and the browser reached its published project page.
